Welcome to TIMAYA

We help shape spaces you are proud to call yours.

TIMAYA Aluminium provides aluminium solutions for residential and commercial buildings. We combine practical advice, careful measurements and attention to detail to help deliver a finish that looks right and works hard.

  • Solutions for new builds and renovations
  • Window frames, glazing and aluminium work
  • Roofing-related aluminium services
  • Clear communication throughout your project
